तुम्हें शाम में फिटनेस चाहिए या आराम, या फिर काम पर फोकस?

Option 2: Tech/AI day 3-4 hours ka. Ek chhota side project pick kar lo, like aapka favorite model ko fine-tune/optimize karke ek mini demo bana do, then rest of day hobbies.

Option 3: EV/auto + food crawl. Kisi showroom ya EV event type cheez dekh lo, phir 2-3 cafes me sequential tasting.

Option 4: Full reset. Grocery + laundry + organize, phir evening me library/book store ya casual meet-up.

Agar outing wali mood: Indore me koi new place explore, friends ke saath casual dinner, aur thoda photography type roaming.
